The '''Imperial compound''' was a multi-facility complex that served as [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]]'s [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] consulate and estate on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

The complex was situated in the northern are of [[Tal'cara]], between the government plaza and the [[Bothan police force]] headquarters.<ref name="guide" />

Inside, the consulate had [[barracks/Legends|barracks]] that supported a small contingent of 24 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]s and an elite force of [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]]. A long low guest house served as the base of operations for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit [[Beldonna's League|Beldonna's Legion]], which Halsek kept on personal retainer for extra security. There was also a [[hangar/Legends|hangar]] for vehicle storage and maintenance (the scouts operated [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]); about these, lay a spacious training ground.<ref name="guide" />

Halsek resided with his closest advisors in a huge opulent estate, staffed by servants and [[servant droid/Legends|servant droids]]. Outside was a garden where unusual plant specimens flourished.<ref name="guide" />

Externally, the complex was surrounded by a [[durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] wall ten [[meter/Legends|meters]] high, with only one fortified gate on the southern side. Constant patrols ensured that only high-ranking Imperial or [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] officials passed through it.<ref name="guide" />
